name: 91 dominoes (double-12)
description: 91 dominoes (double-12) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

overview.description: 91 dominoes (double-12) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

history.origins: Double-12 set (91 tiles, 0-0 through 12-12). Block/draw dominoes; same matching rules. Largest common set; allows many players or long games.
timeline: 13th century: domino tiles documented in China.
18th century: modern European dominoes appear in France.
history.cultural: Domino games; double-12 for large groups.

rules.objective: Play all tiles first, or have fewest pips if blocked.
rules.gameplay: Highest double leads. Match to open ends; doubles crosswise. Block: pass if cannot play. Draw: draw from boneyard until playable. Winner scores opponents' pips or lowest if blocked.
keyRules: Match to open ends; doubles crosswise

strategy.basic: Match tile ends; block or draw; go out to win.
strategy.intermediate: Track high doubles and suit distribution; 91 tiles = large set.
strategy.advanced: Plan for long games; partnership if 4-hand.
tips: Block or draw variants; more players possible.

variations.name: Block
variations.description: Players pass when they cannot play; no drawing from the boneyard. Game ends when no one can play. Lowest pip count in hand wins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Block variant uses different draw rules; engine overrides not yet modeled.

variations.name: Draw
variations.description: When a player cannot play, they draw from the boneyard until they can play or the boneyard is empty. First to play all tiles wins; if blocked, lowest pip count wins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Draw variant uses boneyard; engine overrides not yet modeled.

scoring.description: Block/draw variant: play all or lowest pips if blocked.
scoring.winCondition: First to play all tiles or lowest pips remaining.
